author: easemize
name: animated-3d-mac-book-air
description: Showcase a stunning, purely CSS-driven 3D animation of a MacBook Air with this React component. Leveraging Tailwind CSS for styling and custom CSS keyframes for complex animations, this component brings a realistic and dynamic laptop to life. It includes animations for full 360-degree rotation, lid opening and closing, a screen reflection effect, and even subtle keyboard key presses. Ideal as a hero element, a sophisticated loader, or just a cool visual flourish for your React applications.
